subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should sandboxed MCP App `ui/message` requests be categorically unable to invoke both slash and bang command syntax through the chat-send path?
rationale: The implementation currently blocks slash commands but not the previously identified host-only bang-command path; choosing an exception would define a durable command-authority contract rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Reject all command prefixes
options.body: Reject both `/` and `!` before showing consent or dispatching text, preserving the PR's stated plain-text-only boundary.

options.title: Allow a defined bang subset
options.body: Document and test an explicit safe allowlist only if maintainers intentionally want MCP Apps to reach specific bang commands.

recommendation.title: Reject all command prefixes
recommendation.body: Reject both `/` and `!` before showing consent or dispatching text, preserving the PR's stated plain-text-only boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed bridge behavior and described its intended command-safety contract in the PR.
